Home / PRIVACYPRIVACY

Your information.
A defined purpose.

This notice explains how information submitted through the contact form is processed.

The information we request

The form collects your name, email address, enquiry topic and message. Your organisation and telephone number are optional. Do not submit passwords, health data, confidential documents or other sensitive information.

The purpose

This information is used to review your enquiry, contact you and prepare a possible business discussion. The form does not subscribe you to a newsletter.

How your enquiry is sent

The form uses FormSubmit to forward your enquiry to contact@iconsultingcabinet.com. FormSubmit therefore processes the submitted data. Its documentation states that submissions are retained in its archive for 30 days. Its spam protection may use reCAPTCHA.

Read the FormSubmit privacy policy for details about this service.

Enquiries about your data

To request information about, correction of or deletion of data shared with iConsulting, email contact@iconsultingcabinet.com.

Browsing this website

This website’s code does not include audience analytics or advertising trackers. The hosting provider may process technical data required to deliver and secure the pages. Images and graphic assets are hosted on the website.
